title: 樂詞網
author: National Academy for Educational Research (國家教育研究院)
description: 1,286,299 Chinese technical and academic terms with their English equivalents and subject labels, from 240 term lists on the NAER Web of Words (樂詞網), updated up to 2026-11-11. Taiwan terms and their mainland Chinese equivalents are both headwords and point to each other. Simplified and traditional lookup forms; no frequency data.
attribution: Term data from 國家教育研究院 樂詞網 (National Academy for Educational Research, Web of Words), https://terms.naer.edu.tw/, used under the site's open data declaration (政府網站資料開放宣告). Terms were regrouped by headword and converted to simplified Chinese.
